note: 只收录因子形状的 analysis 能力（有序列/bar 输入且有数值输出）。upstream 为 null 表示本地解析不到实现，需安装 capability SDK 才能执行。

capabilities.name: additive_combine
capabilities.description: Sum signals with direction sign. Bullish adds, bearish subtracts.

capabilities.name: additive_combine_series
capabilities.description: Additive sum of signed score contributions per bar.

capabilities.name: adx
capabilities.description: Average Directional Index plus +DI / -DI.

capabilities.name: aroon
capabilities.display_name: Aroon Up, Aroon Down, and Aroon Oscillator
capabilities.description: Aroon Up, Aroon Down, and Aroon Oscillator (Tushar Chande, 1995).

capabilities.name: atr
capabilities.description: Compute the average true range (ATR) and its ratio to price; used to size volatility, filter abnormal markets and estimate stop distance.

capabilities.name: atr_ratio
capabilities.display_name: ATR as a percentage of the current close price
capabilities.description: ATR as a percentage of the current close price.

capabilities.name: awesome_oscillator
capabilities.description: Awesome Oscillator (Bill Williams).

capabilities.name: basis
capabilities.description: Basis in basis points: (futures - spot) / spot * 10_000.

capabilities.name: basis_zscore
capabilities.description: Rolling z-score of the basis (1d on 15m bars when period=96).

capabilities.name: bb_bandwidth
capabilities.description: Bollinger Band bandwidth: (upper - lower) / middle * 100.

capabilities.name: bb_pct_b
capabilities.description: Bollinger %B: position of price within the band, (price - lower) / (upper - lower).

capabilities.name: bollinger
capabilities.description: Compute the Bollinger middle band, upper and lower bands, bandwidth and %B over a close series; used to judge band-riding, breakouts and volatility contraction or expansion. The middle band is a period-bar SMA; the outer bands are the middle band ± multiplier × population standard deviation.

capabilities.name: bos_choch_detect
capabilities.description: Detect Break of Structure (BOS) and Change of Character (CHoCH) events.

capabilities.name: candle_body_measure
capabilities.description: Candle body size; unit=absolute (|close-open|) or pct (body as a share of the full range).

capabilities.name: candle_lower_shadow_measure
capabilities.description: Lower shadow length; unit=absolute or pct.

capabilities.name: candle_range
capabilities.description: Bar high-low range.

capabilities.name: candle_upper_shadow_measure
capabilities.description: Upper shadow length; unit=absolute or pct.

capabilities.name: cci
capabilities.description: Commodity Channel Index — Lambert (1980).

capabilities.name: circuit_breaker_check
capabilities.display_name: Aggregate risk checks; halt if any fired
capabilities.description: Aggregate risk checks; halt if any fired.

capabilities.name: cmf
capabilities.description: Chaikin Money Flow — accumulation/distribution over `period`.

capabilities.name: conflict_detect
capabilities.description: Detect direction conflicts between two sets of dict-shaped signals.

capabilities.name: cross_validate
capabilities.description: Check if multiple :class:`AtomicScore` objects agree on direction.

capabilities.name: cvd
capabilities.description: Cumulative Volume Delta = cumsum(buy - sell).

capabilities.name: dual_speed_atr
capabilities.description: Compare fast vs slow ATR to detect volatility expansion / contraction.

capabilities.name: ema
capabilities.description: Compute the EMA of a close series (SMA seeded, then advanced bar by bar); used for trend judgment and comparisons such as price falling below the moving average.

capabilities.name: equal_highs_lows
capabilities.description: Identify equal-highs and equal-lows clusters in a rolling pivot window.

capabilities.name: fair_value_gap
capabilities.description: Identify Fair Value Gap (FVG / imbalance) zones.

capabilities.name: fractal_pivot
capabilities.description: SMC fractal pivot detection; side=high or low.

capabilities.name: heikin_ashi
capabilities.description: Heikin Ashi candle transformation.

capabilities.name: hierarchical_combine
capabilities.description: Hierarchical tiered scoring. Two calling conventions:.

capabilities.name: ichimoku
capabilities.description: Ichimoku Cloud (5 components).

capabilities.name: large_print_zscore
capabilities.description: Rolling z-score of bar volume — useful for tagging unusually large prints.

capabilities.name: liquidation_imbalance
capabilities.display_name: Rolling long-liq vs short-liq imbalance ratio
capabilities.description: Rolling long-liq vs short-liq imbalance ratio.

capabilities.name: liquidity_sweep_detect
capabilities.display_name: Detect bearish and bullish liquidity sweeps
capabilities.description: Detect bearish and bullish liquidity sweeps.

capabilities.name: macd
capabilities.description: Compute the MACD line, signal line and histogram over a close series; used for trend following and momentum reversals. A histogram turning from negative to positive is the familiar golden cross. The EMA definition matches official.compute.ema (SMA seeded).

capabilities.name: majority_vote
capabilities.description: Direction by majority vote. Score = (bullish - bearish) / total.

capabilities.name: majority_vote_series
capabilities.description: Majority direction vote per bar.

capabilities.name: mfi
capabilities.description: Money Flow Index — RSI computed on typical price × volume.

capabilities.name: moving_average
capabilities.description: Extended moving averages: dema (double EMA) / tema (triple EMA) / wma (linearly weighted) / hma (Hull) / rma (Wilder) / trix (rate of change of a triple EMA), dispatched by kind. sma and ema stay separate — their output field names differ.
capabilities.declared_source: merged: dema · tema · wma · hma · rma · trix

capabilities.name: nbar_trailing_tp
capabilities.description: Trail stop to lowest-low (long) / highest-high (short) of last *n_bars*.

capabilities.name: obv
capabilities.description: On-Balance Volume.

capabilities.name: oi_change_pct
capabilities.display_name: Change in open interest over *periods* bars
capabilities.description: Change in open interest over *periods* bars.

capabilities.name: order_block_detect
capabilities.description: Detect Order Blocks (OB) formed at Break-of-Structure events.

capabilities.name: order_imbalance
capabilities.description: Per-bar buy/sell imbalance in [-1, 1].

capabilities.name: orderbook_slippage
capabilities.description: Walk the order book level by level to estimate the average fill price and slippage in bps, and judge whether it stays within an acceptable range; used to avoid dumping into very thin liquidity.

capabilities.name: parabolic_sar
capabilities.description: Parabolic SAR (Wilder).

capabilities.name: pct_change
capabilities.description: Compute the percent change of a price series over a given window; used for window tests such as down more than 1.2% in 30 minutes or VIX up more than 8%.

capabilities.name: pivot_points
capabilities.description: Standard (Floor) Pivot Points + R1/R2/R3 + S1/S2/S3.

capabilities.name: premium_discount_zone
capabilities.description: Label each bar as PREMIUM, DISCOUNT, or EQUILIBRIUM.

capabilities.name: pvt
capabilities.description: Price-Volume Trend (PVT, Joseph Granville's modification of OBV).

capabilities.name: range_gain_pct
capabilities.description: How far the window's HIGH sits above the window's LOW, in percent.

capabilities.name: rolling_extreme
capabilities.description: Rolling N-bar extreme; op=max (highest) or min (lowest).

capabilities.name: rolling_quantile
capabilities.description: Rolling quantile (0 <= q <= 1).

capabilities.name: rolling_zscore
capabilities.description: Rolling z-score: (x - mean) / std over *period* bars.

capabilities.name: rsi
capabilities.description: Compute the RSI (0-100) of a close series; used to judge overbought and oversold conditions and momentum exhaustion. Defaults to Wilder recursive smoothing, matching mainstream charting software; method=simple uses a plain average over the window instead.

capabilities.name: sequential_filter
capabilities.description: Count signals passing min_strength; fire when bullish/bearish quota met.

capabilities.name: sequential_filter_series
capabilities.description: Count of signals passing the minimum strength threshold per bar.

capabilities.name: sma
capabilities.description: Compute the arithmetic mean of the last period bars of a close series, current bar included; used as a trend baseline and for comparisons such as price holding above or falling below the average. For exponential weighting use official.compute.ema.

capabilities.name: smart_money_inflow
capabilities.display_name: Rolling net taker-buy USD over *period* bars
capabilities.description: Rolling net taker-buy USD over *period* bars.

capabilities.name: soft_factor
capabilities.description: Tiered scoring factor; first matching threshold wins.

capabilities.name: stochastic
capabilities.description: Stochastic Oscillator (slow).

capabilities.name: stochrsi
capabilities.description: Stochastic RSI — momentum oscillator combining RSI and Stochastic.

capabilities.name: supertrend
capabilities.description: SuperTrend indicator (canonical implementation).

capabilities.name: swing_pivot
capabilities.description: Swing high/low detection; side=high or low.

capabilities.name: trend_channel
capabilities.description: Upper/middle/lower channel: donchian (rolling high/low/mid) or keltner (EMA plus ATR bands). config is the union of both — donchian reads only period, keltner also reads atr_period and multiplier.

capabilities.name: trend_strength
capabilities.description: Composite trend strength: 0.0 (choppy) → 1.0 (strong directional move).

capabilities.name: true_range
capabilities.description: Wilder's True Range = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|).

capabilities.name: vectorized_backtest
capabilities.description: Run one backtest over a set of klines and a pair of precomputed long/short signal series, reporting total return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate, trade count and net PnL after fees and slippage; used for historical validation and cost simulation before a strategy trades real money. The signals are computed by other capabilities and passed in — this capability only matches trades and tallies the result.

capabilities.name: volume_ma
capabilities.description: Simple moving average of volume.

capabilities.name: volume_ratio
capabilities.description: Compare the current bar volume with the average of the previous N bars to get an expansion ratio; used to confirm that a price move is backed by real trading.

capabilities.name: volume_zscore
capabilities.display_name: Volume z-score using rolling mean & std-dev
capabilities.description: Volume z-score using rolling mean & std-dev.

capabilities.name: vwap
capabilities.description: Compute the volume-weighted average price over a set of klines (typical price = (high+low+close)/3); used to judge whether price has fallen below VWAP.

capabilities.name: vwma
capabilities.description: Volume-weighted moving average — Σ(price × volume) / Σ(volume).

capabilities.name: weighted_composite
capabilities.description: Weighted sum of atomic-shaped signals.

capabilities.name: williams_r
capabilities.description: Williams %R — momentum oscillator from highest-high range.

capabilities.name: zigzag
capabilities.display_name: ZigZag pivot detector by percentage deviation
capabilities.description: ZigZag pivot detector by percentage deviation.
